 ## 0.16.0 (2022-xx-xx)
 
+### BREAKING
+
+- Old ACL syntax is no longer supported ("users" & "ports" -> "src" & "dst"). Please check [the new syntax](https://tailscale.com/kb/1018/acls/).
+
 ### Changes
 
 - **Drop** armhf (32-bit ARM) support. [#609](https://github.com/juanfont/headscale/pull/609)
